responsibility: This file implements the frontend-side diagnostic formatting layer for GCC Rust. It expands Rust/GCC-specific printf extensions such as `%m`, `%q`, and quote markers, caches backend quote characters, constructs `Rust::Error` objects, and routes errors, warnings, notes, fatals, and debug messages to the backend diagnostic hooks declared in `rust-diagnostics.h`, making it the formatting and message-construction bridge above GCC's concrete diagnostic engine.
same_name_distinction: Implements the diagnostic interface declared in `rust-diagnostics.h`: it expands the Rust/GCC-specific format extensions (`%m`, `%q`, `%<`, `%>`), caches backend quote characters via `rust_be_get_quotechars`, builds `Rust::Error` messages, and forwards finished strings to the backend emission hooks. Unlike the header, this `.cc` file is the concrete formatting and dispatch implementation.
